en: I make promises that I don’t really intendto keep.
zh: 我会做出自己其实并不打算兑现的承诺。

en: I make up stories about things that happened that are totally untrue.
zh: 我会就发生过的事编造完全不符合事实的说法。

en: I never know where my emotions will go from moment to moment.
zh: 我从不知道自己的情绪下一刻会转向哪里

en: I never show emotions to others.
zh: 我从不对他人表露情绪（I never show emotions to others.）

en: I never take risks.
zh: 我从不冒险（I never take risks.）

en: I never want tobe alone.
zh: 我从不想独自一人

en: I often “zone out”and then suddenly come to and realize that a lot of timehas passed.
zh: 我常常“走神”，然后突然回过神来，发现已经过去了很多时间

en: I often can’t control what I think about.
zh: 我常常无法控制自己在想什么

en: I often feel just miserable.
zh: 我常常感到十分痛苦

en: I often feel like a failure.
zh: 我常常觉得自己是个失败者

en: I often feel like nothing I do really matters.
zh: 我常常觉得我做什么都无关紧要

en: I often forget to pay my bills.
zh: 我常常忘记付账单

en: I often get into physical fights.
zh: 我常常和别人动手打架

en: I often have ideas that are too unusual to explain to anyone.
zh: 我常常有一些离奇得无法向任何人解释的想法（I often have ideas that are too unusual to explain to anyone.）

en: I often have thoughts that make sense to me but that other people say are strange.
zh: 我常常有一些自己觉得有道理、别人却说很奇怪的想法

en: I often have to deal with people who are less important than me.
zh: 我常常不得不与不如我重要的人打交道

en: I often have unusual experiences, such as sensing the presence of someone who isn’t actually there.
zh: 我常常有不同寻常的体验，比如感到有某人在场，其实那人并不在（I often have unusual experiences, such as sensing the presence of someone who isn’t actually there.）

en: I often make up things about myself to help me get what I want.
zh: 我常常编造关于自己的事来帮我得到想要的东西

en: I often say things that others find odd or strange.
zh: 我常常说些别人觉得古怪或奇怪的话

en: I often see unusual connections between things that most people miss.
zh: 我常常看出事物之间大多数人没注意到的奇特联系（I often see unusual connections between things that most people miss.）
